file: 217 The Backrooms Went From One Photo to A24s Biggest Opening.mp4

lines.t: It started as one creepy photo. Now it's A24's biggest opening ever.

full.credit: Clips: Backrooms trailer, A24; Kane Pixels (YouTube)

lines.t: In 2019, someone posted a photo of an empty yellow room on 4chan, and it got a name: the Backrooms.

full.credit: Clips: Backrooms trailer, A24; Kane Pixels (YouTube)

lines.t: In 2022, a teenage YouTuber named Kane Parsons made this video. It has over 97 million views.

full.credit: Clips: Backrooms trailer, A24; Kane Pixels (YouTube)

lines.t: A24 made it a movie. It opened on May 29th with 81 million dollars, A24's biggest opening ever.

full.credit: Clips: Backrooms trailer, A24; Kane Pixels (YouTube)
